participation.context: Told the descent, refused the fool's news, and left the chronicle open.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Priced dinner at threepence, named the loaf, and left the cat on the book.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asked about the fall and the fool, and did not measure the bread.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Compared the descent to cloth lowered, and let the hard part wait.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: she will have the plot and the loaf in the same hour
relations.quote: A finger and a half short of the notch, and a penny, and you will not measure it either.

story.body: You reported a king on the ground and a play with no fool. You did not tell Kemp. You did not shut Field's book, and you did not send it back.

relations.note: she will have the plot and the loaf in the same hour
relations.quote: A finger and a half short of the notch, and a penny, and you will not measure it either.

title: Ate the short loaf and reported the king on the ground
